reviewedMechanics.gravel: Original normal Attack has additionalTimes=1 and splitDamage=1. Post-mitigation split interpretation is corroborated by the independent akdata calculator and secondary gameplay notes, not an extracted executable game formula: two half-output Physical damage events, target hurt-SP on the first only. Skills def_atten/shield_atten use one-second triggers and source duration. def_atten action enum MULTIPLIER is interpreted as the direct percentage bucket, distinct from FINAL_SCALER. E2 aura applies DEF PERCENTAGE to deployed allies with base cost <=10; remove on owner detach. Cost talent remains own stat.
reviewedMechanics.ethan: Ground-only all-target selectors in every mode. Trait evade 50% Physical/Arts and lower target priority. Talent additive active Bind with independent prob per target, source frozen_duration, S2 scales only prob. S1 poison source NoSourceDamage MAGICAL, no delay-free first trigger, interval1s; single source-independent buff (maxStack1) with serialized overrideType3.
reviewedMechanics.shaw: Normal/S1 target count limited to current block count. S1/S2 Physical projectiles travel10tiles/sec and apply damage/push on impact. Active buff knockback[dir] uses source direction and subtracts2 force levels off-direction; S2 selector unbounded on source two frontal tiles. Trait can deploy high ground. Talent RES ADDITION. Shared displacement currently instantaneous; original continuous movement and projectile collision collateral remain presentation/mechanics scope limitations.
reviewedMechanics.rope: Normal/S1/S2 Physical hook projectiles travel10tiles/sec; skill hook pullSourceOffset=.5. Skill cast waits for every hook impact/fizzle, source linkDuration1 then minPostDelay1, blocking attacks/SP until done. S2 targets at most max_target2 in extended range. Talent Physical dodge and dual-tile deployment. Shared pull currently instantaneous, with actual hook visual deferred.

ethanOverride.interpretation: Single nonstacking poison buff refresh preserves one-second tick cadence. Numeric enum3 mapping to EXTEND is inferred and not independently recovered from game code.
